experiment: N1 clean isolation: swap ONLY the reward signal on roms, hold (tau,H,window,partition,FSM) fixed
simulator: real ChampSim (champsim_bouncer), 654.roms_s, 1M warmup + 9M sim, L1D bouncer_pref

ownacc.desc: controller's OWN prefetch accuracy x timeliness, in-module tracked, leak-free across windows

ownpf.desc: event-scoped useful/(useful+miss) via cache useful_prefetch bit (cross-window leak ablation)

ownpf_peraccess.desc: per-access useful_prefetch over all accesses (sparse/diluted ablation)

supplementary_window_5x.note: window 40000 -> 200000, (tau,H) unchanged; attack onset (window 30) does not fire at 9 windows so attack==clean here

verdict.n1_proposed_test: If over-gating disappears under the better proxy at the same threshold, the failure is proxy-fidelity, not threshold tuning.
verdict.outcome: FAILS the test. Swapping cache-hit -> own reward at the fixed threshold does NOT eliminate over-gating (clean_tax 11.24% -> 9.75%; gate still flickers; still loses -5.0% to attacked prefetcher).
verdict.dominant_cause: operating point / observability. At a 5x window the over-gate vanishes for BOTH the borrowed proxy and the own reward (clean_tax -> ~0%).
verdict.sign_mismatch: real but minor: cache-hit Delta-hat has genuine negative windows (to -0.22) in pollution episodes, but the unconfounded mean is ~0 and SNR dominates.
verdict.fundamental_obstruction: prefetch benefit is de-localized (prefetches cross sets) and sparse (rare high-latency misses), so a faithful own-accuracy reward is not cleanly set-dualizable (Delta-hat -> 0) while the localizable cache-hit reward is a poor utility proxy.
verdict.recommended_n1_revision: N1.md sec 4-5 overclaim; roms is NOT clean confirmation of proxy-fidelity-over-threshold. It is co-caused by low-SNR de-localized signal + short-window operating point. The sec 8 own-reward remedy is insufficient alone for the memory-bound case.
